provenance.quantile_method: numpy linear interpolation; exact exported probabilities; no error clipping
provenance.local_selection: exact probability >=0.1, inclusive; no selection by beam output
provenance.rna_weighting: equal RNA weight; means/maxima computed inside each selected RNA first
provenance.local_weighting: pooled bases, pairs, or windows; overlapping windows are descriptive, not independent replicates
provenance.missing: empty eligible domains are NA and omitted from quantiles; zeros in nonempty domains retained
provenance.storage: tar member streams; no extraction; temporary SQLite only in node-local scratch
provenance.scope: same S/G/model; exact uncapped, beam b=20/50/100/200 with h=d=max(b,30); total accessibility only
